details: Integrated images/profile.jfif and images/profile.jpg into About Me editorial card with signature seal and Contact section identity avatar.

Engineered a multi-layered, eye-friendly ambient background system: slow-drifting atmospheric gradient orbs (CSS blur 100px) and delicate studio stardust motes (HTML5 Canvas). Features zero eye strain, automatic theme adaptation (dark obsidian & light gallery paper), performance optimizations (paused on hidden tab, DPR clamped), and full prefers-reduced-motion accessibility.
Updated all logo instances across the website to use images/logo crop.png: browser favicon/website icon, navigation header brand seal, profile photo artist seal stamp, and footer brand mark.

Extracted user uploaded image media_1788792857417.jpg, cleanly stripped fake checkerboard background with connected-component noise removal and boundary anti-aliasing. Saved images/logo-transparent.png, images/logo-square.png, images/favicon-64.png, images/favicon-32.png, favicon.ico, and images/favicon.svg. Configured as the primary website icon across all devices and browsers.

Executed approved implementation plan: 1) Removed solid white background from profile portrait into images/profile-cutout.png (32-bit transparent ARGB with soft alpha feathered contour); 2) Applied frosted gradient fade dissolving lower torso into the card; 3) Relocated authentic signature seal logo directly beneath the photo with negative margin; 4) Built interactive hover animation popping out 7 real artwork circular thumbnail badges in a radial crescent orbit with tooltips, smooth spring expansion, and clean retraction back into the logo on hover out; 5) Integrated lightbox click triggers and mobile tap toggle.

Restored authentic original portrait photo (images/profile.jpg) without gradient fade overlay or torso masking, while retaining the signature logo in the center below the photo and the full interactive pop-out artwork constellation animation.

Relocated the 'Ronille Alcala • Digital Artist' badge outside the profile photo stage and positioned it directly on top of the picture with refined pill styling, pulsing crimson beacon, and hover lift.

Upgraded contact form from dummy state to functional Web3Forms API delivery directly to Gmail. Configured hidden honeypot bot trap (_botcheck), custom subject line, animated loading spinner with button disable, client-side email/name/message validation, and real-time success feedback.
Inserted user's personal Web3Forms Access Key into index.html. Contact form is now live and actively forwarding visitor inquiries directly to Ronille's Gmail inbox.
